description_en: Queries the list of unsupported ports for a hybrid cloud
description_zh: 查询混合云不可用的端口列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-unsupport-ports --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudUnsupportPorts

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of your WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

HttpPorts.description_en: The list of ports for the HTTP protocol. The value is a string. Multiple ports are returned in the port1,port2,port3 format
HttpPorts.description_zh:
HTTP协议的可用端口列表。  取值为字符串，
多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回

HttpsPorts.description_en: The list of ports for the HTTPS protocol. The value is a string. Multiple ports are returned in the port1,port2,port3 format
HttpsPorts.description_zh: HTTPS协议的端口列表。 取值为字符串， 多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回
